title: Alberto the best sailor
text:
Alberto, brave sailor at sea,
You sail with passion, without fear of shipwreck. Alberto is a crack 👌
author: 413martp

title: Unforgettable
text: We had Alberto as our skipper, he made the trip very entertaining and super enjoyable, highly recommended. It has been an unforgettable experience and we have enjoyed it. The perfect treatment by all the workers, very friendly and interact with customers. We have fallen short of what we have enjoyed and how well we have been treated, drinks and food included. Without a doubt there will be a next one.
author: K5979ELcarols

title: Private sailing trip
text: Alberto was the most amazing guide! We had the time of our lives! Beautiful sunset trip and it was the perfect end our trip
